name: Zodiarc Ring
source:
Two additional stories focused on Zodiarc's protagonists
Chapter 1. "Arcana Gakuen" is a prequel drawing school life before the main events.
Chapter 2. "Mephistopheles" is about main character getting involved in an incident of Mephistopheles waking up every night.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/08/vn-of-month-june-2008-rui-wa-tomo-o-yobu.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
两部聚焦《佐迪亚克》主角的追加故事。
第一章“阿卡纳学园”是前传，描绘主线事件前的校园生活。
第二章“梅菲斯特”讲述主人公卷入梅菲斯特每晚苏醒的事件。

[来源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/08/vn-of-month-june-2008-rui-wa-tomo-o-yobu.html]vndbreview[/url]]
